description: Explicit crosswalk from upstream routing ids R0-R40 to stable reverse-skill route/skill ids. status=adopted (module migrated), superseded (domain handled by a different stable route), rejected (module not adopted; benchmark cases expect no_route unless the hint independently matches an adopted route). mapped_route=null means the upstream domain has no stable route in this package.
